Priya: Pool, and please bring plates/utensils if you can. I can bring napkins + hand sanitizer.
Ari: Great — will order a veggie + meat tray and a couple of loaves. Who's ok with chipping in $8? React or say 'I can' ;)
Devon: I can
Jen: I can
Sam: Can do

Ari: Awesome — final check: rain prob is 30% so plan B is 4th floor common room at noon. If you have strong game recs drop them here. See you all! :lantern:
